# An excerpt of two board traces of a window frame that starts from the old
# image, for the frame builder's colour preload proof in the XRGB8888 and
# RGB565 layouts (src/mali/frame_preload_tests.rs): each run's second
# frame, the command-stream words of its draw and the raw memory of the
# buffer that holds its framebuffer descriptor and its pre-frame draw.
#
# Board: NanoPC-T6 (RK3588, Mali-G610, GPU_ID 0xa8670005), Armbian,
# Linux 6.18.55-current-rockchip64, panthor 1.5.0, Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1.
# The program, 0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-19-preload-formats/preload_fmt.c:
# a 64x48 pbuffer of the config; frame 1 clears it blue and draws red over
# columns 0-31; glFinish; frame 2 draws green over columns 16-47 without a
# clear; "not as predicted 0", rc 0, by tools/mali/mesa-board-ref.sh
# (PAN_MESA_DEBUG=linear,nocrc,dump,trace,sync):
#   mesa-xrgb8888: mesa-xrgb8888.pandecode sha256 cde45ef7a458d6d54515fc197df80fe47d315c56d367c3f8bdb85c576ad0cd5a
#   mesa-rgb565: mesa-rgb565.pandecode sha256 12d58bfb6037af3d36fce2ad563440bb9bfd621a56e46b51799c98610c6bfed0
# Cut by tools/mali/board_dump_cut.py --from <line> (past the first frame's
# dump: xrgb8888 1310, rgb565 1312). Each block is headed by its line range
# in the full file.
